content.comment_body: Looking ahead, is it possible to enable datalog access directly on the web interface by clicking the SD card icon, without relying on [product_name] or [product_name]? Ideally, this could be done while the controller is operating, without needing to stop the program.
No, that's not currently possible. Also, consider posting all your feature requests in a single wishlist thread rather than creating separate topics for each suggestion.
Hello, I have several [product_name] controllers and encounter the same challenge. Datalogging is not straightforward, and I hope this feature will be enhanced in future versions.
This issue has been present since [article_no]. [company_name] has been aware of these user requests for a long time, but rarely addresses them or implements the desired improvements.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are dissatisfied with the inability to conveniently access datalog files from their controller’s web interface, wanting simple download functionality from the SD card while the device is active. They describe datalogging as complicated, with ongoing requests for improvements not meaningfully addressed by [company_name].
analysis.user_expectations: Users want an easy way to download datalog files from the controller’s web interface via the SD card icon—without pausing device operation or relying on additional external tools.
pain_keywords: must stop program for data access
